reconcile.note: Henry distinguishes Genesis 6:5's evil done continually from 8:21's evil from youth, reading ongoing sin as grounds for judgment, innate weakness as grounds for mercy.

sides.snippet: every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually
sides.verseText: Yahweh saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.

sides.snippet: the imagination of man's heart is evil from his youth
sides.verseText: Yahweh smelled the sweet savor. Yahweh said in his heart, \"I will not again curse the ground any more for man's sake, because the imagination of man's heart is evil from his youth; neither will I ever again strike everything living, as I have done.
